svg.text: • WARFARIN + CLOPIDOGREL: Heightened risk of major systemic and GI hemorrhage.
• CLOPIDOGREL + OMEPRAZOLE: Omeprazole inhibits CYP2C19, decreasing clopidogrel efficacy.
• Maintain strictly consistent dietary Vitamin K intake while on Warfarin.
